:::{#exm-optimization-algorithm}
#### Exhaustive search over a finite feasible set

Let $f(\vx) = x_1^2 + x_2^2$ and let the feasible set be the three points
$\cb{\tp{(1, 0.5)}, \tp{(3, -1)}, \tp{(-1, 2)}}$ of the line of @exm-feasible-set.
The procedure "evaluate $f$ at every feasible point and return the point with the smallest [value](functions.qmd#def-value)" is an [optimization algorithm](#def-optimization-algorithm).
Computing $f$ at each point gives

$$
\begin{aligned}
f(1, 0.5) &= 1 + 0.25 = 1.25, \\
f(3, -1) &= 9 + 1 = 10, \\
f(-1, 2) &= 1 + 4 = 5,
\end{aligned}
$$

so it returns $\tp{(1, 0.5)}$, a [minimizer of $f$ over this feasible set](#def-minimizer-over-feasible-set).

:::
